notes.title: R-Type Delta: HD Boosted announced for release in November
notes.notes: A PlayStation classic returns. The shoot 'em up R-Type Delta: HD Boosted was announced with a PC release coming in November.Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/08/r-type-delta-hd-boosted-announced-for-release-in-november/
